criteria.text: Flutter-spawned shared services preserve configured renderer origins and add the exact rhythm://app origin once.
The local API guard and CORS path allow rhythm://app on loopback while rejecting untrusted origins.
The engine receives rhythm://app in its CORS options without dropping explicit development origins.
Restored and already-open artifact tabs load actual artifact content and never render as ready with an empty frame.
Artifact panes have stable UUID identity and do not bleed toolbar state or content when switching tabs.
Every open artifact pane remains mounted across tab switches and navigation away from Dashboard.
A newly opened tab updates route-persistent auth state after preference persistence succeeds.
